scope: Python SDK 0.2.0a5 fight optimization; uncommitted working tree based on ae3413a. No Java/transport changes.
assessment: CONDITIONAL PASS: executed source/installed-package component checks pass; optimized graphical gameplay remains UNVERIFIED / NOT RUN until MCP reload and native retest.

construction.continuity: melee_wait_seconds default 3, domain 0..5. Inability to approach safely or pursuit off causes stationary, freshly checked waits, not vertical movement. One context owns cooldown/session across knockback.
construction.bounds: Continuous wait deadline is not reset by target ID changes. Zero retains legacy immediate blocked results; grace expiry returns the original reason. Earlier duration/timeout, cancel, actor, health, terrain and evasion checks still apply.
construction.equipment: Cache only scheduling information. Initial weapon gate, fresh pre-movement inventory and fresh post-aim pre-attack inventory remain. Final cooldown uses max(current,prior interval).
construction.preparation: Begin rendered aim preparation 75 ms before cached cooldown eligibility, wait 80 ms for render, then apply the fresh final cooldown/actor/target/health gates; preparation is never attack authorization.
construction.observability: Publish attack receipt counts immediately and during airborne recovery; wait/aim/cooldown/target/crosshair reasons are exposed. No gameplay outcome inferred from counts.

preserved.native_authority: No replacement physics, collision, damage, crafting or cooldown engine.
preserved.fences: Same immutable actor session on every look/drive/attack and exact refreshed target entity ID on attack.
preserved.cleanup: Core single ownership, cooperative checks, final release and success downgrade on unconfirmed release unchanged.
preserved.safety: No unsupported route projection, inventory rearrangement, player selection, whitelist expansion, creeper chasing, new RPC or autopilot policy relaxation.
preserved.transport: TLS, per-instance trust/hostname checks, API key, loopback defaults, queue bounds and F8 unchanged.

checks.model_continuity: FO01: six attacks and repeated out-of-reach knockback complete in one simulated job, no movement, cooldowns preserved, counters remain receipt-only.

live_optimization.reason: Pi's registered process still uses a4 until /reload; no optimized gameplay behavior is claimed.

benchmark.scope: Six static-target attacks, deterministic fake clock and mocked primitives, no RPC latency; NOT Minecraft FPS/latency evidence.
benchmark.note: Counts include navigation, inventory, scene, look, stop and attacks. Navigation/health polling is retained; no production timing or damage-rate guarantee follows.
